Probate-Sisco

Preserved Primary Document • probt-s5.htm

Be it remembered that on the ninth day of December in the year of our Lord one thousand eight hundred and fourteen, Letters of Administration on the estate of Amelia Handsor dec'd were in due form of Law granted unto John Francisco who being sworn gave bond with Robert Thompson on his surity in the sum of one thousand dollars as (unclear) Bond filio.
